title: feat(service-storage)!: a declared multi-replica boot on a local storage root refuses unless the root is declared shared
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9W6HuoQgWWG9KM4QzAKqxek)_

Fixes #31931

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a new operator variable, `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED`, is read; and a deployment that declares several replicas over the redis cluster driver and keeps the local storage adapter, which booted on `main`, is now refused unless it sets that variable. Measured with a real `os start` on base (boots) and head (exit 1), below.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the storage adapter or a replica deployment; the two deployment docs pages that do are updated here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：声明多副本(OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE / OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS>1)且 cluster 走 redis 时，文件存储若是本地目录，启动直接拒绝(exit 1),管理员在设置里把存储改回本地也不生效;除非设 `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED=true` 声明这个目录是所有副本共用的同一个卷。
- 为什么改：多副本各写各的盘，在 A 副本上传的文件到 B 副本就 404,而每个副本都显示健康;这是多副本高可用(cloud#3814)的第 28 行。
- 风险与回滚：只影响"声明多副本 + redis + 本地存储"这一种部署，单节点、其他 cluster driver、S3 完全不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR,或给受影响部署设开关/改用 S3。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts`(新的第二个 `kernel:ready` 钩子与 `applySettings` 里的换装拒绝)、`multi-replica-local-root.ts`(判定与文案)、`storage-service-plugin.test.ts` 末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/storage-service-plugin.test.ts -t cloud#3814`,预期 8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Boot refusal.** `StorageServicePlugin.start()` registers a second `kernel:ready` hook after the one that applies the `storage` settings. It reads the adapter that will actually serve (`this.target`) and throws `MULTI_REPLICA_LOCAL_STORAGE_REFUSAL` when that adapter is local, `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis(process.env, composedClusterDriver(ctx))` is true, and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED` is not `true`. The check sits at `kernel:ready`, not `init()`, because `os serve` always constructs the local adapter and S3 arrives from the `storage` settings (`OS_STORAGE_ADAPTER=s3` / `OS_STORAGE_S3_*` or an admin save), swapped in at that hook. A `kernel:ready` throw fails the boot before any socket opens.
- **Settings-change refusal.** Under the same condition, `applySettings` refuses a swap onto a local adapter: it logs the same refusal once at `error` with "The storage settings change was NOT applied", and the current adapter keeps serving.
- **The switch.** `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED=true` (trimmed, case-insensitive, the split-brain guard's reading) declares the local root one volume every replica mounts. A declaration, not a probe. Environment only: no settings key, no constructor option, no spec key.
- **New dependency edge.** `@objectstack/service-storage` now depends on `@objectstack/service-cluster` (`declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`, `composedClusterDriver`), the same edge `@objectstack/service-cache` already has. `service-cluster` depends only on `core` and `spec`, so there is no cycle, and the CLI's no-direct-cluster-dependency rule is untouched (it reads the CLI's own manifest).
- **Shape.** Same as the existing boot refusals (split-brain guard, the shared cache, the `os start` auth secret): a pure predicate, one message constant, a throw. No new error code, no `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` row. The new module's exports stay internal to the package.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` gains the variable's row; `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` "Scaling beyond one node" gains a paragraph (S3, or one shared volume; `ReadWriteOnce` cannot be shared).
- Changeset `.changeset/31931-storage-local-root-replicas.md`: `@objectstack/service-storage` patch, BREAKING banner, migration, ADR-0087 disposition.

## Why

On the local adapter every replica writes uploads to its own disk, so a file uploaded through one replica is a 404 on the others while every replica reports healthy (cloud#3814 inventory row 28). The rulings bind the change to the declared-multi-replica-on-redis condition only (R3): the single-node path, any other cluster driver and S3 are unchanged.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `storage-service-plugin.test.ts` (the plugin's existing harness file), 8 cases:

- PIN: declared + redis + local + no switch → the boot rejects with the refusal, which names `OS_STORAGE_ADAPTER=s3` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED=true`. (RED on `main`: the boot resolves.)
- declared + redis + local + switch (`' TRUE '`) → boots, local adapter serves.
- declared + redis + settings selecting S3 → boots, S3 adapter serves.
- CONTROL ×3 (green either way by construction, not ablation evidence): undeclared + redis; declared + memory driver; declared + no cluster service → boots on local.
- PIN: booted on S3, a settings change onto local → error logged, the S3 adapter is still the one serving.
- with the switch, the same change applies and nothing is logged at `error`.

No existing test changed.

## Acceptance notes

- The Compose multi-replica example and the Helm chart live in the cloud repository, not here: setting the switch on a shared Compose volume and moving Helm (`ReadWriteOnce`) to S3 is cloud-side work (carrier: cloud, cloud#3814). The single-replica `create-objectstack` compose template is unchanged.
- One-shot kernels (the CLI's data-migration plugins) compose no cluster service, so the predicate is false there and they are unchanged.

## Verification

All readings on head `8c0e68df` unless stated.

<details><summary>Package tests, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` → Test Files 76 passed (76), Tests 1436 passed (1436); `typecheck` (tsc, scripts tsconfig, test-typecheck) exit 0; under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-storage/src` → exit 0 (the package has no `lint` script).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, src imported relatively, no dist leg)</summary>

- A1: the boot `throw new Error(MULTI_REPLICA_LOCAL_STORAGE_REFUSAL)` replaced by a no-op → the boot-refusal pin goes RED (`AssertionError: promise resolved "undefined" instead of rejecting`), 1 failed / 7 passed; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- A2: the swap guard's `return` removed → the settings-change pin goes RED (`expected LocalStorageAdapter{…} to be S3StorageAdapter{…}`), 1 failed / 7 passed; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Real `os start` (built CLI, real redis-server, a scratch host app declaring both cluster packages with an allowing multi-node gate)</summary>

Env on every leg: `OS_CLUSTER_DRIVER=redis`, `OS_REDIS_URL` to a local `redis-server`, `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` on a scratch dir, a SQLite `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` / `OS_SECRET_KEY` set.

- BASE (`main` 489f0cea, its own built CLI): `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`, no switch → `/api/v1/ready` 200 after ~7 s on the local root — the defect.
- HEAD: `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`, no switch → exit 1, the refusal printed as the boot's failure line.
- HEAD: `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true` + `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED=true` → `/api/v1/ready` 200 after ~7 s, no refusal.
- HEAD: `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true` + `OS_STORAGE_ADAPTER=s3` + `OS_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET` / `OS_STORAGE_S3_REGION` → `/api/v1/ready` 200, no refusal.
- HEAD: `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE` empty (CONTROL) → `/api/v1/ready` 200, no refusal.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates and dogfood</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 118 families on 8c0e68df; every one run locally after the last commit, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 118 derived, 118 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On the first head (a97bd03f) `check:test-source-alias` was red (the new `@objectstack/service-cluster` import resolved through `dist/`); 8c0e68df adds the anchored vitest alias it prescribes. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone first. Package tests/typecheck/lint were re-run on 8c0e68df: 76/76 files, 1436/1436 tests, exit 0.

Full dogfood battery (title carries `!`, `Clause-②` carries `(narrowing)`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock on a97bd03f, closure built first → VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 442 passed | 3 skipped (445), Tests 3669 passed | 42 skipped (3711). The one later commit, 8c0e68df, touches only `packages/services/service-storage/vitest.config.ts` (an alias the dogfood suite never reads), so the battery was not re-run on it.

</details>

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (`OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_SHARED` follows the `OS_{DOMAIN}_{NAME}` shape; seat-ruled over the `_ENABLED` form because it declares a fact, not a feature.)
